crew_chat_action_images_add_a_screenshot: Button on a refused-work card: adds the marked screenshot that goes with a retry.
crew_chat_action_images_group: Accessible name of the group of screenshots attached to a retry on a refused-work card.
crew_chat_action_text_answer_submit: Button that sends the typed answer of an action card.
crew_chat_approval_prompt_allow: Button of the approval bubble: lets the crewmate run the tool.
crew_chat_approval_prompt_allowed_by_you: Line that replaces the approval bubble once the user allowed the tool; {time} is the local time of the answer.
crew_chat_approval_prompt_deny: Button of the approval bubble: refuses the tool.
crew_chat_approval_prompt_wants_to_run: Start of the approval bubble title: the crewmate asks permission to run a tool; the tool name follows in bold.

crew_chat_ask_card_dismiss.description: Accessible name of the × that closes a crewmate's question card.
crew_chat_ask_card_dismiss.distinct: the × of a question card; the crash card's Dismiss is another area

crew_chat_ask_card_type_your_own_answer: Placeholder of the free-text answer box of a crewmate's question card.
crew_chat_composer_attach: Accessible name of the + button of the message box: opens the image picker.
crew_chat_composer_attach_images: Accessible name of the hidden file input of the message box.
crew_chat_composer_attached_images: Accessible name of the list of images attached to a task, pending or sent.
crew_chat_composer_queued_tasks: Hint under the message box: how many tasks wait behind the running one. Shown only when above zero.
crew_chat_composer_remove_image: Accessible name of the small button that removes one pending image; {name} is the file name.
crew_chat_composer_send: Accessible name of the send button of the message box.
crew_chat_composer_ui_usage: Error toast when the user sends a bare /ui command. /ui is a command prefix and stays as typed; the example after it is a prompt a person might write.
crew_chat_header_crewmate_settings_name: Accessible name of the chat header button that opens the crewmate's settings; {name} is the crewmate.
crew_chat_header_needs_you: Status under the crewmate's name when it waits for the user.
crew_chat_header_server_offline: Banner under the chat header when the crew server is unreachable; {server} is its name.
crew_chat_header_server_offline_unnamed: Banner under the chat header when the crew server is unreachable and has no name to show.
crew_chat_header_stop: Chat header button that stops the running task.
crew_chat_header_stop_the_current_task: Tooltip of the Stop button of the chat header.
crew_chat_header_terminal: Chat header button that opens the running task in a terminal.
crew_chat_header_watch_in_a_terminal: Tooltip of the Terminal button of the chat header.
crew_chat_header_working: Status line under the crewmate's name in the chat header while a task runs and its start time is unknown.
crew_chat_header_working_elapsed: Status line in the chat header while a task runs; {elapsed} is a compact duration such as 3m or 1h 2m.
crew_chat_setup_conversation_placeholder: Placeholder of the answer box for any other setup question.
Placeholder of the answer box while the crewmate asks for its own name.
Placeholder of the answer box while the crewmate asks which project to work on; the step can be skipped.
crew_chat_setup_conversation_setup_answe: Accessible name of the answer box of the first-run conversation with a new crewmate. Code finds the box by data-composer, never by this text.
crew_chat_setup_conversation_setup_conve: Accessible name of the thread of the first-run conversation with a new crewmate.
crew_chat_setup_conversation_thinking: Label of the typing indicator while the crewmate prepares its next setup question.
crew_chat_task_action_card_cancel_task: Button of the GitHub card: cancels the waiting task.
crew_chat_task_action_card_connect: Button of the GitHub card: starts the GitHub sign-in.
crew_chat_task_action_card_connect_githu: Title of the card shown when a task waits for a GitHub connection.
crew_chat_task_action_card_connected_as_: Line of the GitHub card once connected; {account} is the GitHub user name with its @.
crew_chat_task_action_card_enter_value: Placeholder of the box of an input action card.
crew_chat_task_action_card_not_now: Button of the automation card: declines for now.
crew_chat_task_action_card_override: Button of a refused-work card: accepts the work although the checks refused it.
crew_chat_task_action_card_prove_ui_fail: Title of the card shown when the UI gate refuses a task for lack of captures; {crewmateName} is the crewmate's name.
crew_chat_task_action_card_response: Accessible name of the answer box of a generic action card.
crew_chat_task_action_card_response_need: Title of the generic action card when the crewmate gave no question of its own.
crew_chat_task_action_card_retry_with_th: Button of a refused-work card: sends the task back to the crewmate with the listed reasons.
crew_chat_task_action_card_sign_in_hint: Body of the engine sign-in card. Done is the button of the same card.
crew_chat_task_action_card_sign_in_to_en: Title of the card shown when a task waits for an engine sign-in; {engine} is the engine name.
crew_chat_task_action_card_wants_to_add_: Title of the card where a crewmate proposes an automation; {crewmateName} is the crewmate.
crew_chat_task_action_card_work_refused: Title of the card shown when the checks refuse a crewmate's work; {crewmateName} is the crewmate's name.
crew_chat_task_message_downloading_prepa: Line under a task's prompt while the crew server downloads the repository; {preparing} is what is downloading.
crew_chat_task_message_failed: Message in the failed task's bubble when hostd gave no error text.
crew_chat_task_message_open_terminal: Tooltip of the hover button of a running task that opens its terminal.
crew_chat_task_reply_automation_added: Note under a reply: the proposed automation was added.

crew_chat_task_reply_done.description: Reply shown for a finished task that returned no text.
crew_chat_task_reply_done.distinct: a task state shown as a reply, not the Done button

crew_chat_task_reply_not_added: Note under a reply: the proposed automation was declined.
crew_chat_task_reply_see_full_reply: Button under a summarized reply: shows the full text.
crew_chat_task_reply_show_less: Button that folds a long reply back to its first lines.
crew_chat_task_reply_show_more: Button that unfolds a long reply.
crew_chat_task_reply_show_summary: Button under a full reply: goes back to the summary.
crew_chat_task_reply_usage_tokens: Usage footer under a reply: tokens read and written; both are compact counts such as 1.2k.
crew_chat_thread_empty: Empty state of the task thread.
crew_chat_thread_jump_to_present: Pill over the thread when the user scrolled up: jumps to the latest message.
crew_chat_thread_new: Divider label before the tasks that arrived since the user last looked. Capital letters on purpose.
crew_chat_thread_task_history: Accessible name of the scrolling task thread.
